_note: Core-gameplay checklists. `auto` rules are evaluated by the checklist engine against derived state; null = manual tick with `detection` as a hint.

categories.blurb: The essential engineers that define most ship builds. Unlocking is step one — grade them up for the strongest blueprints.

items.description: The single most important engineer: grade 5 FSD range, plus thrusters and sensors. Needs 1 Meta-Alloy.
Early FSD engineer and a stepping stone toward Palin. Unlock by travelling 300 Ly from start.
Grade 5 power distributor mods — essential for combat and mining. Unlock by using 5 black markets.
Grade 5 multi-cannons and railguns. Core combat engineer. Deliver 15 bounty vouchers.
Grade 5 armour and hull reinforcement — critical survivability. Mine 500 t of ore.

items.item: Unlock Professor Palin (Dirty Drive Tuning — Arque)
items.description: Grade 5 Dirty Drive Tuning for maximum thruster speed. Requires 5,000 Ly from start + Qwent G3.

items.item: Unlock a shield engineer (Lei Cheung / Didi Vatermann)
items.description: Lei Cheung grades shield generators; Didi Vatermann grades shield boosters. Defines any defensive build.
Unlocking is only step one — raise reputation with an engineer to Grade 5 to access the strongest blueprints.

categories.blurb: Ancient Guardian technology — the Guardian FSD Booster and anti-Xeno weapons are near-mandatory endgame gear.

items.item: Visit a Guardian Ruins / Structure site
items.description: Travel to the Guardian regions (around Synuefe / Col 173) and activate a site with an SRV to farm blueprint fragments and materials.

items.item: Obtain a Guardian module blueprint fragment
items.description: Solve the pylon/relic puzzle at a Guardian structure to receive the blueprint fragment required for module unlocks.
The highest-impact Guardian module — a flat jump-range bonus (up to +10.56 Ly). Unlocked at a Guardian Tech Broker.
Guardian anti-Xeno weapons — essential for Thargoid combat. Gauss cannons are the AX meta.
Guardian Module/Shield/Hull Reinforcement improve survivability, especially vs Thargoids.

items.item: Run Ram Tah's Guardian mission line (Meene)
items.description: 'Decoding the Ancient Ruins/Tombs' missions reward credits and lore and complement Guardian farming.

categories.blurb: From the first honk to the neutron highway and landmark expeditions.

items.description: Fire the Discovery Scanner on arrival to reveal all bodies — the foundational exploration action.

items.item: Complete a full FSS scan of a system
items.description: Resolve every signal in a system, mapping all bodies for maximum data value.

items.item: Map a planet with DSS probes
items.description: Use the Detailed Surface Scanner to probe a body — required for bio/geo signals and the mapping bonus.

items.item: Run the Road to Riches route
items.description: Scan and map high-value bodies (ELWs, water worlds, terraformables) along a curated route for fast credits and rank.
Turn in your first batch of cartographic data at Universal Cartographics.
A landmark rank that unlocks prestige and the Founders World permit.
Fly through a neutron star's jet cone to supercharge the FSD for a ~300% jump-range boost.

items.item: Reach a landmark destination (Sag A* / Colonia / Beagle Point)
items.description: Completing a long expedition to a famous location is a defining exploration achievement.

categories.blurb: Build a fighting ship, engineer it, and put it to work in RES sites and Conflict Zones.

items.description: Buy and outfit a purpose-built combat hull (Vulture, Chieftain, Krait MkII, Python MkII, etc.).

items.item: Engineer thrusters with Dirty Drive Tuning
items.description: The speed needed to win dogfights (Palin/Chloe/Mel Brandon).
Hunt wanted ships in a Resource Extraction Site and cash in bounty vouchers — the core PvE loop.
Join a Conflict Zone for a faction to earn combat bonds and reputation.
Combat Elite (rank 8) — a prestige mastery milestone.

items.item: Equip AX/Guardian weapons and engage Thargoids
items.description: Fit anti-Xeno weaponry and take on Thargoid Scouts/Interceptors.

categories.blurb: Build capital through trade routes and lucrative core mining.

items.description: Buy low and sell high on a commodity loop to build capital and Trade rank.
Trade Elite (rank 8) — a master trader, and a step toward Triple Elite.
Use mining lasers, a refinery, and collector limpets — the entry-level mining loop.
Crack motherlode asteroids with seismic charges to extract high-value cores — the most lucrative mining.
Mining lasers, abrasion blaster, displacement missile, seismic charge launcher, prospector + collector controllers, refinery.

categories.blurb: Suits, weapons, exobiology, and settlement gameplay on foot.

items.item: Disembark and explore on foot for the first time
items.description: Leave your ship/SRV onto a planet or station concourse — the gateway to all Odyssey content.

items.item: Buy your first suits (Maverick / Dominator / Artemis)
items.description: The three specialist suits: scavenging, combat, and exploration/exobiology.
Kinetic, plasma, and laser handheld weapons for combat and settlement raids.
Unlock an on-foot engineer to add mods and raise suit grade.

items.item: Upgrade a suit to a higher grade
items.description: Spend suit-upgrade materials to raise a suit toward Grade 5 for more slots and health.

items.item: Sample & register exobiology (3 samples → Vista Genomics)
items.description: Take three Genetic Sampler scans of an organism, then sell the data at Vista Genomics.
Infiltrate an Odyssey settlement to steal data/goods, complete a mission, or clear hostiles.

categories.blurb: Your personal mobile base with 16 landing pads — the ultimate quality-of-life asset.

items.description: Buy a Drake-class carrier (~5 billion credits).
Mine or buy Tritium and deposit it to enable jumps and upkeep.
Install Refuel, Repair, Rearm, Shipyard, Outfitting, and Market so it's a full-service base.
Plot and execute a carrier hyperspace jump (up to 500 Ly).

items.item: Set buy/sell orders on the carrier market
items.description: Configure commodity trade orders for passing commanders.
Deposit credits and monitor weekly upkeep to avoid decommission.

categories.blurb: Pledge to a galactic Power to earn merits and unlock exclusive modules.

items.description: Pledge allegiance (Powerplay 2.0) to begin earning merits and Power-specific rewards.
Complete Powerplay activities in acquisition/reinforcement systems to accumulate merits.

items.item: Reach a Powerplay rank that unlocks modules
items.description: Climb Power rank to unlock Power-specific modules like Prismatic Shields or Pacifiers.
Buy a Power-locked module after meeting the rank/pledge-time requirement.

categories.blurb: Claim an unpopulated system and build it up from a beacon to a full colony.

items.description: Use a System Colonisation contact to stake a claim on an unpopulated system.

items.item: Deploy the colonization beacon / first construction site
items.description: Deploy the beacon that seeds the initial construction depot.

items.item: Deliver commodities to build the first station
items.description: Haul required construction materials to the depot until the primary starport completes.

items.item: Complete the primary port & take system control
items.description: Finishing the first port establishes the colony and grants control of the system.
Construct outposts, settlements, and orbital installations on other bodies to grow the colony.

categories.blurb: Grow from your first SRV to a full fleet and a 'big three' flagship.

items.item: Deploy an SRV for the first time
items.description: Drop a Scarab or Scorpion from a planetary vehicle hangar to drive on a surface.
Team up in a single ship via multicrew as helm, gunner, or fighter.

items.item: Own a small, a medium, and a large ship
items.description: Progress through ship size classes across your fleet.

items.item: Buy a 'big three' ship (Anaconda / Corvette / Cutter)
items.description: Acquiring an Anaconda, Federal Corvette, or Imperial Cutter is a classic wealth milestone.

items.item: Own a Ship-Launched Fighter and deploy it
items.description: Fit a fighter hangar and launch an SLF, optionally crewed by an NPC pilot.

items.item: Build a fleet and swap between ships
items.description: Store ships across stations and swap for different activities.
